reason: I've already been burned by a designer who took my money and never finished, and now a company in Kuwait with no UK office and no past clients wants half up front by PayPal. I'm not handing over 50% to people I can't go and find if it goes wrong.

would_change_my_mind: Real local clients I could phone myself, and no big deposit, so I pay only once I've seen the design working.
